title: 250. Minimum Array End

examples.explanation: The array [4, 5, 6] is valid since 4 AND 5 AND 6 = 4 and the elements are strictly increasing. 6 is the minimum possible value of nums[2].
The array [7, 15] is valid since 7 AND 15 = 7 and the elements are strictly increasing. 15 is the minimum possible value of nums[1].

hints: Every element in the array must contain all the set bits of x, since their bitwise AND must equal x.
The minimum possible nums[n - 1] is formed by "merging" x with n - 1: keep the set bits of x, and place the bits of n - 1 into the lowest free (zero) bit positions of x.
So the result is x with n - 1 inserted into its zero bits, which can exceed 32-bit range and must be computed in 64-bit.
